page_title: Chatbox AI: Chat and Work with Multiple AI Models. All in One Place.

sources.entry: Chatbox - User-friendly Desktop Client App for AI Models/LLMs (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Ollama...). [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/chatboxai/chatbox)

summary.name: Chatbox AI
summary.one_liner: Chatbox AI is a privacy-focused desktop, mobile, and web app for chatting with multiple AI models such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and DeepSeek using your own API keys.
use_cases: chat with multiple AI models in one app
ask questions about PDFs, Word files, and images
build a local searchable document knowledge base
run agentic tasks in Work Mode
render Mermaid diagrams and LaTeX formulas in chat
summary.what_it_does: Chatbox gives access to several AI model providers, including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and DeepSeek, through your own API keys or an optional hosted subscription. It can read uploaded files such as PDFs, Word documents, images, and code snippets, then summarize them and answer questions about them. It searches the web in real time for current information. The desktop app includes a local knowledge base for private documents, and Work Mode offers an agent that can write code, use tools, and take actions. It also renders Markdown, Mermaid diagrams, LaTeX formulas, and live code previews, and generates images.
notable: Use your own API keys for many model providers
Local knowledge base stores documents on your device (desktop only)
Work Mode agent for autonomous multi-step tasks
Listed in awesome-mac as open-source and freeware
caveats: Hosted Chatbox AI models require a subscription starting from $3.99/month; free plan has a daily quota for new users
Knowledge Base is exclusive to the desktop app
Knowledge Base files must be under 50 MB and in listed formats
